item.tib: gshen sde'i bca' sgrigs kyi yi ge phan bde'i dbyangs snyan
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni byang pa khro tshang gi gdung son grub chen nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi gdan sa 'dra yul chu mig dgon 'chi med bsam gtan gling gi mkhan chen dam pa bla ma g.yung drung rgyal mtshan gyi thugs bzhed ngor khod spungs dbra zhig ston pas 'phral bris su byas pa dge'o//
